extracted.intended_audience: Minnesotans, readers, donors, potential members and partners of MinnPost (local news consumers and supporters)
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational standards and public commitments describing how MinnPost produces and governs independent, nonprofit journalism — including editorial independence, funding transparency, audience access, ethics, and diversity commitments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Our Mission
rubrics_metrics.description: MinnPost produces independent journalism to serve as a trusted guide for Minnesotans exploring the critical issues, challenges and opportunities facing our state.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains the organization’s purpose: produce independent, in-depth reporting to guide Minnesotans on consequential civic and cultural affairs. States areas of greatest expertise (city and state politics, Minnesota’s congressional delegation in Washington, health, the environment and arts & culture).

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence / No political or commercial interest
rubrics_metrics.description: We have no political or commercial interest. Our only agenda is to be a trusted guide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Affirms editorial independence; used to justify coverage choices and to signal impartiality. Related: MinnPost does not endorse candidates for office or publish unsigned editorials representing an institutional position.

rubrics_metrics.name: No endorsements / No unsigned institutional editorials
rubrics_metrics.description: MinnPost does not endorse candidates for office or publish unsigned editorials representing an institutional position.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies that the organization will not take institutional positions in the form of endorsements or unsigned editorials; commentary pieces are published from community members rather than representing the institution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Free access / No paywalls and content re-publication
rubrics_metrics.description: With a belief that quality journalism is a public good, our reporting is always free to everyone through our website and newsletters. We keep no paywalls, and we openly share our original reporting for re-publication with partners across the state.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policy that all reporting is freely available; encourages redistribution/republishing by partners; signals accessibility as a core value and operational practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adherence to Society of Professional Journalists’ Code of Ethics
rubrics_metrics.description: MinnPost adheres to the Society of Professional Journalists’ Code of Ethics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commits the newsroom to an established professional ethical code (SPJ); implies standards around accuracy, fairness, conflicts of interest, sourcing, and accountability as interpreted by MinnPost.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency about finances and audits
rubrics_metrics.description: MinnPost is committed to transparency, including our own financial information: 2024 MinnPost Form 990; 2024 MinnPost Audit Report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publishes financial documents (Form 990, audit report) to make organizational finances available to the public; part of broader transparency commitments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Donor disclosure and acknowledgment
rubrics_metrics.description: We’re committed to transparency to our readers about the sources of our funding. As of December 2025, MinnPost had over 4,800 member-donor households contributing amounts ranging from $1 to more than $20,000 a year. Over half of our donors are sustaining members who make automatic recurring donations. You can view the 2025 individual donor list here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publishes donor counts, giving ranges, and provides access to individual donor list; acknowledges and recognizes supporters; signals openness about funding composition and scale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Major funders disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Currently, grant support comes from: Arnold Ventures (general operating), the Otto Bremer Trust (Greater Minnesota reporting), the McKnight Foundation (general operating), the Joyce Foundation (effective democracy and environment), the Fund for Nonprofit News at The Miami Foundation (general operating matching funds), Google News Initiative (program support) and the Fredrikson & Byron Foundation (general operating).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists institutional funders by name and (in some cases) purpose of grant support; provides readers context for external funding sources and programmatic support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community-supported model and reliance on multiple revenue sources
rubrics_metrics.description: We believe that in-depth, civic-minded journalism is a community asset... and we rely on individual donors, foundations, advertisers and sponsors to sustain our work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes funding model diversity (members, foundations, advertisers, sponsors), and invites public support (membership/donations) to sustain paywall-free journalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publishing community commentary
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to our in-depth reporting by professional journalists, we publish commentary pieces written by members of our community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes professional reporting from community-contributed commentary; implies editorial policies for commentary (e.g., bylined community pieces rather than unsigned institutional editorials).

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion (board pledge)
rubrics_metrics.description: MinnPost will assure that the diverse experiences and voices of all people of Minnesota and the Native Nations who share that geography are represented and heard in our board, our staff, and in the journalism we produce... The board’s commitment does not signify a moment, but, rather, a journey of reflection and challenging conversations grounded in values of anti-racism and equitable practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Board-adopted pledge describing ongoing commitment to representation, equitable journalism, anti-racism, and workplace inclusion; frames DEI as a continuous process rather than a one-time statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Board governance and public listing of directors
rubrics_metrics.description: The 2026 MinnPost Board of Directors are [names listed]. MinnPost 2026 Board of Directors with affiliations [PDF].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publishes names and affiliations of board members and links to a PDF with affiliations to demonstrate governance transparency and accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope and aim of reporting (in-depth civic and cultural affairs)
rubrics_metrics.description: MinnPost is an independent, nonprofit newsroom producing in-depth reporting on the most consequential civic and cultural affairs in Minnesota. We expose problems, highlight solutions and inspire informed action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets expectation for depth and civic focus of reporting (problem-exposure, solution-highlighting, inspiring action) and orients editorial mission toward public service journalism.
